summary: Finish Fractal naming in phone screens, shared views, Storybook, the Effect SDK and iOS native module build names

replay.detail: Stored messages, replay inputs and protocol values are unchanged.

schema.detail: No database or serialized data changes. Effect schema annotation identifiers now use Fractal.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordinated member upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: The handwritten Effect SDK exports Fractal, FractalLive and FractalPlatform instead of the St3 family; callers migrate together. iOS module source and build identifiers now use Fractal. Existing client classifiers still accept legacy names, and durable keys, storage, wire tags and span names remain unchanged.

downtime.detail: No startup migration or expected interruption.

manual.detail: External Effect SDK consumers must use the Fractal export family. Native iOS builds use the fractal-* module paths and FRACTAL_FABRIC environment names; legacy ST3_FABRIC reads remain supported.

recovery.detail: Persistent state and signing identities are unchanged; no new rollback restrictions.
